image_description: A small, elongated mammal (weasel/ferret) with reddish-brown and cream-colored fur is positioned in green grass. The animal has a slender body, short legs, a pointed snout, and a bushy tail. The lighting appears natural, casting shadows on the grass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small triangular head with pointed snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting a distinct triangular shape tapering to a pointed snout, consistent with mustelid anatomy.
At least one small, dark eye is visible on the side of the head facing the camera.
Short, rounded ears are visible atop the head, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Extremely elongated slender body with remarkably fine, diminutive proportions and lightweight build.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The torso is visibly long and slender relative to its height, characteristic of the weasel family.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short dense fur in brown dorsally with white or yellow ventral coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fur is reddish-brown, and the ventral/chest area shows lighter cream/yellowish tones. Texture appears dense.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some species turn white in winter (ermine morph).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a conditional seasonal trait. The current image shows the brown summer coat, so this specific checkpoint is not applicable/testable for presence in this specific instance.
The neck connects the head to the body with noticeable length, allowing the head to be held high.
The visible forelimbs are short and tucked under the body, consistent with the 'short legs' descriptor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short tail relative to body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible extending behind the animal; while bushy, it is significantly shorter than the main body trunk.

artifact_observations.location: Interface between animal belly and grass
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring at the contact point between the light-colored ventral fur and the green grass blades, indicating minor edge bleeding common in AI generation.
